title: 批注
description: 为图片、视频和支持公共选区的阅读器创建批注与摘录。
author: 资源管理器项目

catalog.usage: 在图片、视频中选择局部，或在文字、PDF、EPUB 等阅读器中选字，创建批注或摘录。

en.原 PDF 已变化，摘录文字仍保留；请核对原文位置。: The source PDF changed. The excerpt is preserved. Check its location.
en.来源已切换或内容已变化，请重新选择文字: Source or content changed. Select the text again.
en.原文位置已失效或暂不支持，摘录和批注仍保留。: The source location is unavailable or unsupported. The excerpt and annotation are retained.
en.选中它，检查器里有原来的那一句: Select it to see the original passage in the inspector
en.条批注在原文里找不到了（原文改过）: annotations could not be located in the edited source
en.写点什么，#标签，回车；Esc 取消: Write a note or #tag. Enter to save, Esc to cancel.
en.拖出一段，或者按 I / O 标记起止，可以批注: Drag a range or press I / O to mark its start and end.
en.在播放器的时间轴上方拖出一段，或者按 I / O 标记起止，就能批注这一段。: Drag a range above the playback timeline, or press I / O to mark a segment for annotation.
en.在图片查看器里拖出一块区域，就能批注这一块。: Drag over an area in the image viewer to annotate it.
en.在 PDF 阅读器里选中文字，就能保存摘录标记，也可以添加批注和标签。: Select text in the PDF reader to save an excerpt, annotation or tags.
en.在阅读器里选中文字，通过选区菜单标记摘录或添加批注。: Select text in the reader and use the selection menu to mark an excerpt or add a note.
en.原 PDF 已变化，请核对摘录位置。: The source PDF changed. Verify the excerpt location.
en.原文改过了，找不到这一句。: The source changed and the passage could not be found.
en.上面是当时划下的原文。: The original selected text is shown above.
en.为图片、视频和支持公共选区的阅读器创建批注与摘录。: Annotate and excerpt images, video and content in compatible readers.
en.在图片、视频中选择局部，或在文字、PDF、EPUB 等阅读器中选字，创建批注或摘: Select an image region, video segment or text in a text, PDF or EPUB reader to create an annotation or excerpt.
